query: Discover Nebraska-style statewide GIS portals for remaining US states not yet built. For each state not yet in the build queue, identify the primary open-data GIS portal URL and platform type (ArcGIS Hub / Socrata / CKAN / other). States already built or queued: Oklahoma City (open-okc.hub.arcgis.com), Memphis (data.memphistn.gov), Lisbon (dados.emel.pt), Kansas (hub.kansasgis.org), Nebraska (nebraskamap.gov), Topeka (performance.topeka.org), Nevada (geohub-ndot.hub.arcgis.com). Remaining US states to check: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas (done), Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska (done), Nevada (done), New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma (OKC done), Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee (Memphis done), Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming. Also: Denver CO, Phoenix AZ, Houston TX, Chicago IL — major city open-data portals. For each, return: state/city name, portal URL, platform type, approximate dataset count if known, any access barriers.
